items.titleEn: The Ministry of Education welcomes the entry of DSE students to 169 Indian universities next month.
items.summaryEn: The Ministry of National Education has announced that the number of Chinese Higher Education Institutions participating in the Hong Kong Secondary School Certificate Examination Program for students in the 2027/28 academic year will increase to 169, the Ministry of Education welcomes this. items.title: 天文台料周三晚氣溫下降 周五周六市區最低氣溫15、16度

In a recent interview with the BBC, Labour MP, Lin Zhengsuan, asked the authorities about the criteria for approving the application. According to the report, the family leave is a necessity of the family, and if they have an emergency, such as a broken car on their way to work, they cannot apply for family leave.
